newsitem.title: THAILAND: TPI Polene slowdown new projects.
newsitem.headline: TPI Polene slowdown new projects.

text.p: Thailand's TPI Polene Plc said on Wednesday that it had decided to slowdown the construction of its fourth cement plant and a power plant because of the country's sluggish economy.

TPI Polene said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the company had so far spent about 1.5 billion baht ($60 million) out of the total investment of nine billion baht in the cement project.
The company said earlier that its fourth cement plant, with daily production capacity of 8,500-tonnes, was scheduled to start operating from end-1998 or in early 1999.
TPI Polene said it was confident that its present projects would produce sufficient revenues for the company to repay debts on schedule.
TPI Polene shares stood unchanged at 18.25 baht at 0745 GMT on Wednesday.
